description: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE April 16, 2026 Contact: press@joannamendoza.com RED ROCK, AZ – Democrat JoAnna Mendoza, retired Marine Corps Drill Instructor and working mom challenging Juan Ciscomani in Arizona’s 6th Congressional District, today announced that her campaign raised more than double the amount of Ciscomani in the first quarter of 2026.
